flags.summary: Ilse began Kestrel Company's roll call at Captain Merrow's table (castle_ravenloft/personal_kestrel:roll_call).
Ilse's Persuasion failed and Merrow called the whole company out of the walls (crg_kestrel_table, the four-soldier fight).
Merrow stood and was counted (Persuasion DC 18) and led the turned company out to meet the dawn; no fight.
The party beat Captain Merrow at his table (crg_kestrel_table); the quest is at count_off.
The party beat the three of the company on the servants' stair (crg_kestrel_cellar, when Vell wasn't with them).
Ilse wrote the last number of the count (the roll call's end, or the coats after the fight).
Tamsin stood before Tatyana's portrait in the court study when the locket was already with Sergei or Ireena.
Silvain found Aurel Mirescu reading by the fire in the court study.
An Arcana attempt on Aurel's charm pulled it tighter; that way is closed.
